description: Fully managed, async-first C# port of RocksDB with on-disk binary compatibility.
Replication (checkpoint + WAL streaming), planned switchover and a Raft cluster layer for RocksDb.Managed. Transport-agnostic.
gRPC (MagicOnion) transport and hosting for RocksDb.Managed.Replication: replication, switchover pair and Raft cluster services.
